response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D language expertise, but has minimal C++ experience (roughly 6 months writing C/C++ components at National Instruments in 2014-2015, plus a bachelor's thesis project) and no evidence of Windows platform development, SQL Server/Oracle work, or fixed income/capital markets domain knowledge. While he did work at RIDE Capital (a fintech), the tech stack used there was Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, not C++. This profile does not meet the mandatory technical requirements of the role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated fintech/investment industry exposure via RIDE Capital
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Negligible hands-on C++ experience (~6 months) far below the 5-10 years required
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle database experience (uses MySQL/MongoDB)
No Windows platform development background; career is Linux/web-centric

key_factors.factor: No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
Limited/no fixed income or capital markets domain expertise
